In addition, tasks are structured into distinct modes: parallel for simultaneous dimension consideration, serial for chain dependencies, conditional for adaptability to varying conditions, and nested for hierarchical structures.
Information Extraction focuses on extracting key information such as named entity recognition, keyword annotation, and entity relationships.
Programming-Related tasks evaluate programming understanding through code generation, debugging, and explanation capabilities.
This system categorizes constraints into four primary types: Content Constraints, Situation Constraints, Style Constraints, and Format Constraints.
Content Constraints. These ensure the text follows specific thematic topics, inclusion/exclusion criteria, values, tone, style, privacy considerations, and numerical precision.
Format Constraints. These ensure adherence to essential structural requirements such as output formats, text patterns, grammar, accurate sentence structure, and hierarchical organization.

We employ GPT-4o (OpenAI, 2023) as the evaluation model to assess constraint adherence in generated responses in LLM-as-judge manner
Instruction-Level Accuracy (ILA) measures the success rate of individual instructions by averaging compliance across all instructions within a single instance.
Constraint-Level Accuracy (CLA) assesses the fulfillment of individual constraints, making it crucial for identifying specific requirement violations.
These metrics progressively assess compliance at different granularities: from strict instructionlevel compliance (ILA) to fine-grained constraintlevel analysis (CLA).

To address these challenges, we propose Segment Policy Optimization (SegPO), which incorporates reasoning mechanisms and segmentlevel evaluation into the advantage computation.
Our rulebased system mandates that reasoning is enclosed between ‘start_think’ and ‘end_think’ tags, and answers between ‘start_answer’ and ‘end_answer’.
We assess ILAi and CLAi metrics using state-of-the-art LLMs (i.e., Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct)
We compare the performance of both proprietary and open-source LLMs trained on diverse corpora.

This configuration enables the completion of all tasks in roughly 30 minutes.
